key_findings: Chronic morphine upregulates spinal TCF7L2, which transcriptionally regulates TLR4 and activates TLR4/NF-kB/NLRP3 in microglia.
TCF7L2 depletion alleviated morphine tolerance and pain hypersensitivity.
